text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
"I was hanging out with my friends, so I 
got home a little late!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you need to tell her when 
you'll be home. You shouldn't worry your 
mother too much!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
"I was only a little late... Fine, 
whatever!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'm not done talking yet—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa, I really need to speak more calmly...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What am I doing getting all fired up 
too... Jeez.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Ines Fujin slumped in dejection 
over her own inadequacy.
